blockingFindings.description: Directly inspected all five current V19 angle images and all six V19 pose renders. The neutral/front three-quarter views still show the overskirt gathered into a hard central folded mass, and the back view retains a raised center patch. Crouch and sit still show two narrow pointed tails extending below the seat. Shortening the panels from 95 mm to 65 mm reduced free-hanging depth but did not resolve the pose collapse. Appearance remains rejected.

V19 crouch and sit views still leave the inner-hip and seat coverage boundary unclear where the shorts, thighs and overskirt overlap. Static renders do not establish continuous coverage, clearance or strain; fit and coverage remain unverified and rejected.

V19 front, side, back and posed renders continue to show pronounced triangular faceting and uneven surface finish across the jacket sleeves, shoulders, torso and waist. Surface quality remains rejected.

outOfScope: VRChat Build & Test and runtime inspection
